project.name: Arncroach
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 11 of 14. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Kellie Castle is a separate attraction outside the strict village boundary. Private listed houses and steadings are not promoted.
